title: Franklin mailing services facility to close just three years after opening, laying off over 100 workers
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Business Postal Center International’s closure is part of a multi-state shutdown that will eliminate 457 jobs across three states.
Florida-based Postal Center International is closing its Franklin facility and laying off 112 workers, just three years after opening the site as its New England hub.
The closure is part of a larger shutdown of PCI operations across three states, affecting 457 workers.
